name: Aquatic Form
summary: You return to Darnassus with the restored Pendant of the Sea Lion. The rite teaches Alliance druids to attune their spirits to deep waters.

sections.title: A Sacred Bond with the Depths
sections.body: For Cenarion Circle initiates, shapeshifting joins the druid’s spirit to the wild aspects of Azeroth. After enduring trials in the dark coastal depths and in Moonglade, young night elf druids receive the assembled Pendant of the Sea Lion from Dendrite Starblaze. They carry the sacred token back to Teldrassil as proof of their respect for the laws of air, water, and breath.

sections.title: Return to Darnassus
sections.body: Mathrengyl Bearwalker awaits your return in the Cenarion Enclave. The trials along the coasts of Darkshore and Westfall demand endurance and attunement. Presenting the completed pendant shows Bearwalker that your mind and body are ready to shed their mortal skin and take the swift, breathing form of the sea lion.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Presenting the restored Pendant of the Sea Lion to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus completes an Alliance druid’s training in Aquatic Form. The pendant shows that the druid is ready to learn this aquatic shape.

faq.q: Who sends you back to Darnassus?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze sends you back to Teldrassil from Moonglade after you complete the Trial of the Sea Lion. Starblaze is an elder of the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: Who completes your training in Darnassus?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker, the druid trainer in Darnassus’s Cenarion Enclave, receives your pendant and teaches you the aquatic aspect.

faq.q: What is the Pendant of the Sea Lion?
aliases: pendant of the sea lion lore
faq.answer: The Pendant of the Sea Lion is a sacred talisman made by joining two trial pendants recovered from watery depths off Darkshore and Westfall. It proves a druid has mastered the endurance and patience required of sea creatures.

faq.q: Do Horde druids do this exact quest?
faq.answer: No. Tauren druids also face trials in Moonglade to earn their aquatic aspect, then return to Turak Runetotem on the mesas of Thunder Bluff instead of Darnassus.

faq.q: Where in Darnassus is Mathrengyl Bearwalker?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker is in the Cenarion Enclave, in Darnassus’s northwestern district atop the boughs of Teldrassil.

angles.text: As a druid, this rite marks a step in your communion with nature. Aquatic Form lets you move swiftly underwater and breathe beneath the surface indefinitely.
As a night elf, returning from Moonglade’s timeless woods to Teldrassil’s youthful crown affirms your duty to protect Azeroth’s wilderness amid shifting balance.
As an Alliance druid, your trials prepare you to scout across lakes, rivers, and coastal shores with ease.
